# sfcompute_pools (Data Source)

Reads pools from SF Compute (`GET /v2/pools`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All pools in the provider's workspace (every page is fetched).
data "sfcompute_pools" "all" {}

output "pool_names" {
  value = data.sfcompute_pools.all.data[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the previous page.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by pool ID, resource path, or name (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number)
- `schedule_history_minutes` (Number) How many minutes of past schedule to include.
- `starting_after` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.
- `tag` (List of String) Filter by tag key-value pair (repeatable). Format: `key=value` (the `=` between key and value must be percent-encoded in the URL).
- `tag_key` (List of String) Filter by tag key existence (repeatable). Returns resources that have a tag with this key, regardless of the value.
- `workspace` (String) Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Without it, the returned list spans every workspace where the caller has `Capacity:List` and `Capacity:Read` (granted at either the workspace or organization level). If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `_preview_deployments` (Attributes List) Active deployments targeting this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--_preview_deployments))
- `_preview_procurements` (Attributes List) Active procurements targeting this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--_preview_procurements))
- `allocation_schedule` (Attributes) Allocation schedule of this pool. Add to the schedule by placing buy orders into this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--allocation_schedule))
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a pool resource. Format: sfc:pool:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `tags` (Map of String) Metadata tags attached to this pool.
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this pool belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--workspace))
